ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral area, while low-intensity (black) pixels define the 10-15% perimeter boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone centered on both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a 10-30 pixel-wide band along the trailing edge and expands into solid black regions at the terminal tips. Brownish-yellow clusters are concentrated at the medial base where the fluke meets the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge; left lobe displays high-amplitude, high-frequency serrations (jagged peaks), while the right lobe displays lower-frequency, shallower rounded serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the medial notch extending to sharp, tapered terminal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular grey-scale rings (barnacle scars) detected in clusters across the lower central and right ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of sparse, dark, diagonal linear streaks on the lower right lobe, breaking the uniform white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue irregularity or bio-fouling (dark brown/textured material) on the distal edge of the left tip; yellowish-brown staining at the ventral-peduncle midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular, highly defined circular 'bullseye' scar on the mid-right lobe.
